findings.label: Empty predictions handling
findings.description: When result['predictions'] is empty (fewer than 12 historical data points), lower_bounds and upper_bounds fallback to 0. Verify no upstream consumers assume non-empty forecasts.

findings.label: Chart windowing logic asymmetry
findings.description: JavaScript windowing slices forecast values from a potentially negative index corrected with Math.max(0, ...). Edge case: if only 1–2 historical points exist with a large window selected, slice indices may produce unexpected empty arrays. The historicalValues.length boundary isn't explicitly guarded.

findings.label: Missing Chart.js library guarantee
findings.description: The view inlines a Chart.js instance creation without verifying the library is loaded. If Chart.js is deferred or fails to load, new Chart(ctx, ...) throws a reference error and silently fails with no fallback.

findings.label: No test coverage for algorithm or cache invalidation
findings.description: No unit tests for ConsumptionForecastService->predictNextMonths() edge cases (0–12 readings, 25+ readings), cache invalidation behavior, or integration tests for view rendering. Holt-Winters parameter changes lack validation.
